property_summary: For any single valid play() call sending exactly TICKET_AMOUNT, the reference contract always leaves pot equal to either 0 (if payout occurred) or TICKET_AMOUNT (if payout did not occur); the mutant can produce other pot values by shifting which random branch triggers payout.
change_summary: Change the branch condition to trigger payout when random == 1 instead of 0, which moves when pot is reset and thus observable.
